verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as saved-search alerts or periodic literature updates, is a fair question for an AI research engine, so the axis applies. The pack documents only a REST API and MCP server for "automated searches". These are developer building blocks a user could drive from an external scheduler, and they are one-off calls rather than a recurring schedule the product itself provides. No evidence shows a first-party scheduling, recurring-job or alert capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
